[SWS_DM_00952] Configuration of DTC "max. FDC since clear" as extended data record
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticPro-
videdDataMapping.dataProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParame-
ter.dataElement is set to DEM_MAX_FDC_SINCE_LAST_CLEAR, the DM shall report
the internal value of the current maximum Fault Detection Counter since last clear
of the contextual DTC in the respective DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord’s Diag-
nosticDataElement.
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
⌋
